contract.note: Four-year, $48M extension ($30M guaranteed, ~$12M/year); tied for largest RB deal alongside Josh Jacobs at signing, 6th-highest RB AAV. Signals Bills view him as long-term lead back through age 30.

scheme.note: Joe Brady (Cook's OC in 2025) was promoted to Bills head coach for 2026. Carmichael Jr. (54, ex-Saints OC 2009-2023 under Sean Payton, most recently Broncos senior offensive assistant) hired as new OC; reporting suggests 'Sean Payton influence' with more under-center play-action tied to Josh Allen.
